Rae: Quick sync 10am today 1: run a tiny launch experiment: free credits + two prompt packs + a single 30-min workshop. Target: boost signup -> 3 queries in 48h by ~10%.

Tom: Sounds tight but doable. Cohort size?

Rae: 300 seeded signups, split A/B. A gets credits+webinar, B gets credits only.

Nora: Prompt packs: 'starter-prototypes' and 'sales-templates'. Short social: `300 free credits + prompt pack -> 30-min live workshop tomorrow. Claim now.`

Ibrahim: Routing: seed links add `?ref=seedX` and set signup metadata `seed=true`. Product should route to templates modal on first login and fire a 24h email nudge.

Rae: Budget: 300*100=30k credits, expected cost low. If spam spikes we pause issuance.

Tom: Metrics I'll track: signup->3queries (48h), avg queries/day, 7d retention. Dashboard link after I wire it.

Nora: Timeline: assets + landing by EOD today, routing live tomorrow 8am PT, influencer posts 10am.

deploy-bot: Created event "Seeded credits workshop" Wed 16:00 PT 1 invites sent to #marketing.

Rae: Action items: Nora (copy + images), Tom (analytics), Ibrahim (routing + utm), I'll finalize list. Check-in 9am tomorrow. :rocket:
